description_en: Retrieves access point information at the user level or bucket level
description_zh: 获取用户级别或Bucket级别的接入点信息
name: ListAccessPoints

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of access points to return. Valid values:

When retrieving user-level access points, the value must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 1000.

When retrieving bucket-level access points, the value must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 100
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回接入点的最大数量。取值如下：

获取用户级别接入点时，取值要求大于0小于等于1000。

获取Bucket级别接入点时，取值要求大于0小于等于100
parameters.name: max_keys

parameters.help_en: The token from which the List operation must start. You can obtain this token from NextContinuationToken in the response
parameters.help_zh: 指定List操作需要从此token开始。您可从返回结果中的NextContinuationToken获取此token
parameters.name: continuation_token
